notes:
Kinch — table notes

Concept. A Jedi training droid, two hundred years on Coruscant, who always knew the nice children were the wrong target. Hammer-sees-nails: offering to fight someone is, sincerely, a friendly gesture — it is what he was built for and did for centuries. Plays for comedy. Punches; does little else.

The build (second pass). The "multiclass droid" route to a Crit 1 punch: Steel Hand Adept plus Martial Artist for Iron Body ×4, which takes the standard Brawl critical rating from 5 to 1 — and since a Brawl weapon augments an unarmed attack (core rules; Sam Stewart's ruling), the vamblades swing at that rating too. Paid for with Brawn 5 → 2 and three bought Brawl ranks: the pool stays 2 yellow + 3 green, the damage does not (fists 2, blades 3).

How he fights (the player's own notes)

  • Up to four hits a round: a crit on a hit (1 Advantage now), then Precision Strike (Improved) (2 strain) turns it into Overpowered — a free second attack with the same pool — and 2 Advantage on each attack lands the off-hand vamblade as well.
  • Discouraging Wound via Precision Strike (1 strain): landed on an NPC, flips a dark-side Destiny Point to light. He seizes fate by the throat.
  • Martial Grace (2 strain): adds his Coordination ranks to the next Brawl hit — worth nothing until he buys Coordination.
  • Against vehicles with armour 0 he can crit with his fists once a hit deals damage (10 damage after the ÷10 — four Successes); armour 1 stops him cold. He has no Gunnery.
  • Warrior duel option, at the GM's discretion: forgo the initiative roll for an Average Perception or Knowledge check for a boost die against one chosen enemy — the stare-down.
  • Took the +10 Obligation options (+5 XP, +1,000 credits) — both spent.

Rules check (GM)

  • Crit 1 is legitimate now (Iron Body ×4: 5 − 4 = 1), for fists and for the vamblades alike. A crit costs 1 Advantage; the four-hit round needs 3 Advantage on the first roll (1 for the crit, 2 for the off-hand).
  • But a crit needs the hit to deal damage. Damage is 3 (blades) or 2 (fists) plus net Successes, against soak 3–5 on most of the Run's enforcers: he needs 1–3 net Successes before the crit can fire at all. Brawn 2 is the price of Crit 1; it is a real price.
  • Brawl rank 5 at character creation breaks the creation cap (no skill above rank 2 at creation). Two ranks are free (career + spec); the three bought ranks — 60 XP — are the problem. Ian's call: waive the cap, or send those 60 XP back to Brawn (2 → 3 is 30) and toughness.
  • The Jedi Training Suit is not equipped in this export (soak 3 instead of 5). Probably an accident of the rebuild; worn armour costs 3 less encumbrance, so it fits under his threshold of 7 alongside the vamblades.
  • The Obligation lost its name and text in the re-export (it is a bare 10 with the options still ticked) and the Purpose motivation is gone; the comlink went too. Re-enter Contract — the Lamplighters' Guild and Purpose: "I was made to punch — what?"; with the four-PC base of 10 the Obligation should carry 20.
  • No Force Rating for a droid despite the Warrior career; the Steel Hand tree's Force talents are closed to him. The sheet prints none.
  • Free career ranks: the app allowed six; a droid Warrior gets 3 + 2 = five. One rank over.

Younglings he remembers (two hundred years of sparring logs; deeds from the record, the rest is Kinch)

JediAt the Temple (approx.)What they didWhat Kinch says
Kerra Holtc. 1042–1035 BBYEvacuated from Aquilaris Minor as a girl by Vannar Treece; his Padawan; made herself "a living weapon" and went back into the Sith-held worlds alone to fight the Calimondra family. Never came out."Arrived at eight with a planet missing. Fought like she meant to get it back by hand. Hit harder than her weight, which is not a phrase I use. She went back into Sith space alone and did not return. I would have gone with her. Nobody asked the droid."
Skere Kaanc. 1060–1050 BBYJedi Master who defected around 1010 BBY, founded the Brotherhood of Darkness, ruled the Sith for a decade as "the Dark One," and died with everyone else at Ruusan."Brilliant, and brilliant at knowing it. Won every match and looked, every time, as if the match had insulted him. I taught him the overhand. I would like it back."
Lord Hoth (Rohlan)c. 1050–1040 BBYJoined the Order to end the Sith single-handed; became the Coruscant Temple's battlemaster and Supreme Commander; built the Army of Light from whatever he could find, including Force-sensitive children; died at Ruusan."Came in at six wanting to end the Sith with one hand. I recommended two. He never forgave me for being right about the second hand."
Pernicarc. 1060s BBYA scribe's son sent to the Order against his wishes; Hoth's closest friend and the peacemaker of the Army of Light; had to kill his own fallen Padawan; died at Ruusan."Did not want to be here. Best footwork of his class because he kept trying to leave the mat. Later killed his own student when the boy fell. I did not teach him that. I taught him the footwork."
Valenthyne Farfallac. 1050s BBYHalf-Bothan Jedi Lord, famously foppish and vain; brought three hundred followers to Ruusan; survived, and led the Order's hunt for Bane afterward."Insisted on being beautiful while losing. Then insisted on being beautiful while winning, which took him longer. The only child who bowed to me after a match. I keep the bow."
Johun Othonec. 1015–1005 BBYTaken into the Order at ten; Hoth's Padawan, then Farfalla's; fought at Ruusan and lost his master to the thought bomb; later the Chancellor's guard."Ten years old — late, for a start — and Hoth's shadow. Blocked like a boy who had already decided the blow was worth taking. Guards a Chancellor now, I hear. Blocking for a living. Consistent."
Kiel Charnyc. 1040s BBYJedi General of the Republic in the New Sith Wars; Githany's lover; murdered on Ruusan by the initiate Darovit."A general's temper at nine. Told me the drill was beneath him. I demonstrated the floor. Murdered by an initiate. I would like a word with the initiate."
Githanyc. 1025–1015 BBYMaster Handa's student who defected to Kaan with the Army of Light's battle plans, betraying Charny; fought with a lightwhip; trained the young Bane on Korriban."Fast, lovely, and always looking at the exit. I logged it. Nobody reads a droid's logs. She left with the Sith and a lightwhip. The whip is cheating. I have said so in writing."
Raskta Lsuc. 1035–1025 BBYEchani, named for the legendary Raskta Fenni; spent her whole career on the blade until she was named Weapons Master of the Order; fought Bane in 980 BBY."Echani. The only child who walked onto the mat already knowing it was a conversation. We spoke for eleven years. Weapons Master, later. I am not surprised, and I am not modest about it."
Sarro Xajc. 1015–1005 BBYEnormous; Raskta Lsu's student; Knighted around 997 BBY and trained to be a Weapon Master after her; died with her against Bane."Huge at twelve and kept apologising for it. I explained that mass is a virtue. He stopped apologising and went to study under Lsu. You are welcome, Sarro."
Worror Dowmatc. 1050s BBYIthorian healer who never once wielded a lightsaber; carried the Army of Light with battle meditation; served under Hoth in the final campaign."Refused, politely, to hit anything, for eight years. Healed the ones I hit instead. I have never been so thoroughly beaten by someone who would not fight."
Fae Covenc. 1030s–1010s BBYJenet; Grand Master of the Order after the Ruusan Reformation; wrote The Jedi Path, the Temple manual handed from Master to Padawan for generations."Took notes during sparring. Notes. Became Grand Master and wrote the manual. There is a paragraph on the low guard I taught her. I am cited nowhere. I am cited nowhere in the whole history of the Order."
Vannar Treecec. 1080s BBYLed the Republic's Outer Rim raids in the Dark Age; lost Aquilaris Minor in 1042 but got one girl out; led Operation Influx and died at Chelloa in 1032."Careful, and then careful again. Fought the way he later planned — three steps ahead, one behind. Died at Chelloa. Careful is not armour."
Gorlan Palladanec. 1070s BBYLeft the Order to stay on occupied Chelloa as a relief worker and miner; ran the resistance; disliked fighting; rescued Kerra Holt."Would not fight. Would not. Sat at the edge of the mat and asked whether I was happy. Stayed on a conquered world to feed people. I have decided that counts."
Tho-Mes Dreiundated (a colleague, not a pupil)Temple instructor known for his lectures on making and keeping promises."Lectured on promises. Made me promise never to strike a lecturer. I kept it for a very long time."

background:
Kinch spent 200 years as a jedi training droid on Coruscant, always knowing there had to
be a better target for his violence than the nice children he was tasked with fighting. One
day he heard a master say, "sometimes, one must take destiny into their own hands" and
he had an epiphany - later that night, Kinch cornered the master alone and unarmed, and
left him covered in Discouraging Wounds before leaping out of a window into a speeder
which was passing below by "chance". Ever since that night, Kinch has seized fate by the
throat in pursuit of proper opponents.
